scope: Independent review of incoming isolated lanes. Resolved-in-source means accepted into the coordinator checkout; it does not mean full gates, trunk integration, installed acceptance or customer recovery. Held findings were sent to their owners and are excluded from the accepted batch until reviewed.

findings.observation: A duplicate completion overwrote held productive work after its tallies were cleared.
findings.requiredBehavior: Retain first completion evidence for the exact run.

findings.observation: Durable receipt write followed by failed read-back left a stale cache that later erased the receipt.
findings.requiredBehavior: Invalidate cache after ambiguous persistence and reload authoritative history before any next write.

findings.observation: Malformed receipt rows and conflicting duplicates were normalized away, allowing overwrite of unknown history.
findings.requiredBehavior: Strictly validate stored evidence separately from tolerant display folding.

findings.observation: Quarantine during a read made corrupt history look absent on the next poll.
findings.requiredBehavior: Preserve corrupt main bytes and unavailable authority until explicit valid restoration.

findings.observation: Supported composed-prop recovery could throw when default canvas allocation failed despite retained CPU pixels.
findings.requiredBehavior: Guard CPU composition, retain authored body and bound retry frequency. The affected modes are absent from current shipped manifests.

findings.observation: New-skill baseline uses an empty digest while evaluator hashes null, preventing genuine receipt approval.
findings.requiredBehavior: Unify canonical absent-baseline digest and prove evaluate-to-promote flow.

findings.observation: Corrections are cut before completeness is measured, so an incomplete prefix can be marked eligible for durable learning.
findings.requiredBehavior: Carry original truncation metadata through arm/correct and test a later reversal.

findings.observation: First-40 selection can drop the newest attributed owner correction in trusted-only evidence.
findings.requiredBehavior: Retain bounded beginning and newest instructions; bind the final host projection limit.

findings.observation: Execution-end recovery files raw output before structured-result repair, then rejects the accepted delivery as duplicate.
findings.requiredBehavior: Respect final delivery authority and test invalid-to-repaired structured output.

findings.observation: Unrelated worker completion reloads the reader's active conversation and discards navigation/inspector state.
findings.requiredBehavior: Refresh only affected state and preserve explicit reader intent.

findings.observation: Newly exposed runtime-lock START FRESH clears durable configuration while existing connector clients can still call tools.
findings.requiredBehavior: Invalidate runtime clients and pending authorization after durable reset succeeds; preserve them when reset fails.

limits: Findings include live application reproductions and narrower in-memory module reproductions; inspect the linked lane evidence for the exact proof boundary.
R05 affects supported renderer modes absent from current shipped manifests; it is not the established cause of the default-art incident.
R08 is a supported-module edge; the reviewed module commits did not yet include final host wiring.
An existing review-window restart gap was also reported to the memory owner; it was not attributed as a new regression.
